💬 Comment “CV” and I’ll share the template used in this reel with you!

Before you send out your next application, save this 👇

A good CV isn’t about fancy designs or big words. It’s about making the recruiter understand your value in a few seconds.

A few things that make a CV stand out:

* Show impact, not just responsibilities. Don’t just tell them what you did. Tell them what changed because of it.
* Use numbers wherever possible. Percentages, targets, savings, team size — quantify your work wherever it makes sense.
* Keep it relevant. Your CV should highlight what matters for the role you’re applying for, not everything you’ve ever done.
* Cut the fluff. Every bullet should add value. If it doesn’t tell the recruiter something meaningful, rethink it.
* Make it easy to scan. Clear headings, consistent formatting and important information that’s easy to find.

And remember, there’s no one “perfect CV” for every job. The goal is to make your experience impossible to overlook.

Save this for your next application & send it to that friend who’s job hunting! 👀

💬 Comment “CV” and I’ll share the template used in this reel with you!

Before you send out your next application, save this 👇

A good CV isn’t about fancy designs or big words. It’s about making the recruiter understand your value in a few seconds.

A few things that make a CV stand out:

* Show impact, not just responsibilities. Don’t just tell them what you did. Tell them what changed because of it.
* Use numbers wherever possible. Percentages, targets, savings, team size — quantify your work wherever it makes sense.
* Keep it relevant. Your CV should highlight what matters for the role you’re applying for, not everything you’ve ever done.
* Cut the fluff. Every bullet should add value. If it doesn’t tell the recruiter something meaningful, rethink it.
* Make it easy to scan. Clear headings, consistent formatting and important information that’s easy to find.

And remember, there’s no one “perfect CV” for every job. The goal is to make your experience impossible to overlook.

Job Description – MIS & Business Analyst

We are hiring an MIS & Business Analyst with 8–10 years of experience, strong BI skills and working knowledge of AI, for our Mumbai office.

Position

MIS & Business Analyst

Company

Unione Group and Moksha Enterprises

Location

Charni Road, Mumbai

Working days

6 days a week

Experience

8–10 years

Must-have

Strong MIS, BI tools, AI knowledge, analytical ability, business acumen

Role Summary

The MIS & Business Analyst turns raw business data into reliable reports, dashboards and insights that leadership can act on. You will own our MIS framework end to end, build BI dashboards, and use AI and automation to make reporting faster and smarter. We want a sharp analytical mind with strong business acumen who can tell management not just what happened, but why and what to do next.

Key ResponsibilitiesMIS and reporting

Design, own and run the MIS framework: daily, weekly and monthly reports for sales, finance, operations and management
Ensure data accuracy by reconciling across systems and fixing gaps at the source
Prepare management reviews and performance packs with clear commentary on drivers, variances and risks
Standardise report formats, definitions and KPIs across teams and businesses

BI and dashboards

Build and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools, with automated data refresh
Create data models, queries and pipelines (SQL, Power Query, DAX) that pull from ERP, Tally, CRM and other sources
Track KPIs such as sales, margins, inventory, collections, productivity and cost, and set up alerts for deviations

Business analysis

Analyse trends, cohorts, profitability and demand to support pricing, planning and growth decisions
Translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into clear recommendations
Support budgeting, forecasting and business reviews with data-backed inputs
Partner with business heads to define requirements for reports, tools and process improvements

AI and automation

Apply AI tools and models to automate reporting, speed up analysis, detect anomalies and improve forecasting
Identify high-value use cases for AI and automation across functions, and run them from pilot to adoption
Use Python, Excel automation or no-code tools to cut manual effort and reduce errors

Stakeholder management

Work with leadership, sales, finance, HR, supply chain and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver insights
Train users on dashboards and self-serve reporting, and drive data-led decision-making across the organisation

Required Qualifications and Skills

Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce, Engineering, Statistics, IT or Business; MBA or a data and analytics certification preferred
8–10 years of experience in MIS, business analysis or data analytics, with at least 3–4 years in a senior or lead role
Strong MIS expertise: building and running reporting frameworks that management relies on
Strong BI skills: expert-level Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling, DAX and dashboard design
Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, complex formulas, macros) and good SQL skills
AI knowledge: hands-on use of AI tools and generative AI for analysis and automation, with understanding of AI use cases in business reporting and forecasting
Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with ERP and accounting data (Tally, SAP or similar) and with sales, inventory and finance metrics
Strong analytical thinking: can break down problems, find the real drivers and present clear conclusions
Sound business acumen: understands how revenue, margin, cost and cash flow link to business performance
Excellent communication and storytelling with data for senior management
Willingness to work six days a week from our Charni Road, Mumbai office

Good to Have

Experience in retail, electronics, distribution or e-commerce businesses
Exposure to cloud data platforms and data warehousing
Experience building AI-assisted reporting, forecasting or automation solutions
Prior experience leading a small MIS or analytics team

Key Competencies

Ownership and accountability
Integrity and confidentiality
Curiosity and a proactive, problem-solving approach
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their updated CV to Hr@moksharetails.com, mentioning current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Description – MIS & Business Analyst

We are hiring an MIS & Business Analyst with 8–10 years of experience, strong BI skills and working knowledge of AI, for our Mumbai office.

Position

MIS & Business Analyst

Company

Unione Group and Moksha Enterprises

Location

Charni Road, Mumbai

Working days

6 days a week

Experience

8–10 years

Must-have

Strong MIS, BI tools, AI knowledge, analytical ability, business acumen

Role Summary

The MIS & Business Analyst turns raw business data into reliable reports, dashboards and insights that leadership can act on. You will own our MIS framework end to end, build BI dashboards, and use AI and automation to make reporting faster and smarter. We want a sharp analytical mind with strong business acumen who can tell management not just what happened, but why and what to do next.

Key ResponsibilitiesMIS and reporting

Design, own and run the MIS framework: daily, weekly and monthly reports for sales, finance, operations and management
Ensure data accuracy by reconciling across systems and fixing gaps at the source
Prepare management reviews and performance packs with clear commentary on drivers, variances and risks
Standardise report formats, definitions and KPIs across teams and businesses

BI and dashboards

Build and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools, with automated data refresh
Create data models, queries and pipelines (SQL, Power Query, DAX) that pull from ERP, Tally, CRM and other sources
Track KPIs such as sales, margins, inventory, collections, productivity and cost, and set up alerts for deviations

Business analysis

Analyse trends, cohorts, profitability and demand to support pricing, planning and growth decisions
Translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into clear recommendations
Support budgeting, forecasting and business reviews with data-backed inputs
Partner with business heads to define requirements for reports, tools and process improvements

AI and automation

Apply AI tools and models to automate reporting, speed up analysis, detect anomalies and improve forecasting
Identify high-value use cases for AI and automation across functions, and run them from pilot to adoption
Use Python, Excel automation or no-code tools to cut manual effort and reduce errors

Stakeholder management

Work with leadership, sales, finance, HR, supply chain and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver insights
Train users on dashboards and self-serve reporting, and drive data-led decision-making across the organisation

Required Qualifications and Skills

Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce, Engineering, Statistics, IT or Business; MBA or a data and analytics certification preferred
8–10 years of experience in MIS, business analysis or data analytics, with at least 3–4 years in a senior or lead role
Strong MIS expertise: building and running reporting frameworks that management relies on
Strong BI skills: expert-level Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling, DAX and dashboard design
Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, complex formulas, macros) and good SQL skills
AI knowledge: hands-on use of AI tools and generative AI for analysis and automation, with understanding of AI use cases in business reporting and forecasting
Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with ERP and accounting data (Tally, SAP or similar) and with sales, inventory and finance metrics
Strong analytical thinking: can break down problems, find the real drivers and present clear conclusions
Sound business acumen: understands how revenue, margin, cost and cash flow link to business performance
Excellent communication and storytelling with data for senior management
Willingness to work six days a week from our Charni Road, Mumbai office

Good to Have

Experience in retail, electronics, distribution or e-commerce businesses
Exposure to cloud data platforms and data warehousing
Experience building AI-assisted reporting, forecasting or automation solutions
Prior experience leading a small MIS or analytics team

Key Competencies

Ownership and accountability
Integrity and confidentiality
Curiosity and a proactive, problem-solving approach
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their updated CV to Hr@moksharetails.com, mentioning current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Analyse trends, cohorts, profitability and demand to support pricing, planning and growth decisions
Translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into clear recommendations
Support budgeting, forecasting and business reviews with data-backed inputs
Partner with business heads to define requirements for reports, tools and process improvements

AI and automation

Apply AI tools and models to automate reporting, speed up analysis, detect anomalies and improve forecasting
Identify high-value use cases for AI and automation across functions, and run them from pilot to adoption
Use Python, Excel automation or no-code tools to cut manual effort and reduce errors

Stakeholder management

Work with leadership, sales, finance, HR, supply chain and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver insights
Train users on dashboards and self-serve reporting, and drive data-led decision-making across the organisation

Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce, Engineering, Statistics, IT or Business; MBA or a data and analytics certification preferred
8–10 years of experience in MIS, business analysis or data analytics, with at least 3–4 years in a senior or lead role
Strong MIS expertise: building and running reporting frameworks that management relies on
Strong BI skills: expert-level Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling, DAX and dashboard design
Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, complex formulas, macros) and good SQL skills
AI knowledge: hands-on use of AI tools and generative AI for analysis and automation, with understanding of AI use cases in business reporting and forecasting
Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with ERP and accounting data (Tally, SAP or similar) and with sales, inventory and finance metrics
Strong analytical thinking: can break down problems, find the real drivers and present clear conclusions
Sound business acumen: understands how revenue, margin, cost and cash flow link to business performance
Excellent communication and storytelling with data for senior management
Willingness to work six days a week from our Charni Road, Mumbai office

Good to Have

Experience in retail, electronics, distribution or e-commerce businesses
Exposure to cloud data platforms and data warehousing
Experience building AI-assisted reporting, forecasting or automation solutions
Prior experience leading a small MIS or analytics team

Ownership and accountability
Integrity and confidentiality
Curiosity and a proactive, problem-solving approach
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Role: Information Security Engineer
Recruiter Email: vgayakwad@firstam.com

Job Description:
Dear ,

We at First American India are currently looking for .Net FullStack Engineers for our office in Hyderabad.

Who are we? First American (India) is a GCC (Global Capability Center) of the First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) family of companies, a proud member of the FORTUNE 500 companies and was named one of FORTUNEs 100 Best Companies to Work For in 2022. First American Financial Corporation provides comprehensive title insurance, closing/settlement, property data and technology solutions. First American (India) creates quality solutions for its customers by combining software, back office and knowledge processing operations to fulfill First American's business requirements. Our priorities are our employees, customers and shareholders - in that order. FAI has been certified a Great Place to work by Great Place to work Institute®, is a certified Best Workplaces for Women and Workplace.

Job Summary:

The Senior Security Engineer – Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) is responsible for supporting the execution and continuous improvement of Information Security GRC activities, with a primary focus on information security control assessments and control testing.

The role will work closely with the U.S. GRC team, Information Security control owners, technical subject matter experts, and business and technology stakeholders to assess control design and operating effectiveness, evaluate risk, document results, and support remediation and governance processes.

The ideal candidate combines strong information security controls assessment experience, practical risk assessment skills, familiarity with security policies and standards, and working knowledge of industry frameworks such as NIST and ISO.

Responsibilities:

Perform information security control assessments, including design effectiveness and operating effectiveness testing, for First American Information Security controls.
Develop and execute control test procedures, identify appropriate evidence requirements, evaluate control populations and samples, and document clear assessment conclusions.
Review policies, standards, procedures, system-generated evidence, reports, screenshots, tickets, and other artifacts to determine whether controls are designed and operating as intended.
Partner with control owners and Information Security subject matter experts to clarify control execution, obtain evidence, validate exceptions, and communicate assessment observations and gaps.
Support Multi-Brand Entity (MBE) control assessments by evaluating control implementation and evidence across applicable entities and documenting assessment results.
Support execution of the Policy Exception Request (PER) process, including review of exception information, coordination with stakeholders and SMEs, risk assessment inputs, follow-up, tracking, and closure activities.
Perform and support information security risk assessments, including evaluation of inherent risk, likelihood, impact, residual risk, and relevant mitigating controls using established methodologies.
Interpret Information Security policies, standards, and control requirements and apply them consistently during control and risk assessments.
Apply and reference industry frameworks and standards such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO/IEC 27001/27002, and other applicable regulatory or control frameworks as required.
Maintain audit-ready assessment workpapers and support tracking of control gaps, remediation actions, due dates, reporting, process improvements, data quality, automation opportunities, and other GRC initiatives as assigned.
Collaborate effectively with U.S. and India-based stakeholders and provide timely, concise, and well-supported inputs for GRC leadership and Information Security governance activities.

Qualifications: (Skills, Knowledge, and Experience)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Risk Management, or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of Information Security experience, with relevant experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance, security controls, audit, or assurance activities.
Hands-on experience performing information security control assessments or control testing, including assessment of control design and operating effectiveness.
Good understanding of control testing concepts, including evidence evaluation, sampling, control populations, test procedures, exception identification, and documentation of conclusions.
Working knowledge of information security risk management concepts, including risk identification, likelihood, impact, inherent risk, residual risk, mitigating controls, and risk treatment.
Experience interpreting and applying Information Security policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements.
Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO/IEC 27001/27002, related security control frameworks, and common Information Security domains such as IAM, vulnerability management, network security, endpoint security, data security, logging and monitoring, incident response, business continuity, and third-party security.
Experience supporting policy exception, risk acceptance, issue management, remediation tracking, or similar governance processes is preferred.
Experience with GRC, workflow, ticketing, or evidence-management tools; familiarity with ServiceNow or similar platforms is preferred.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, documentation, and attention-to-detail skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical SMEs, control owners, business stakeholders, and U.S.-based teams.
Ability to manage multiple assessments and GRC activities, follow defined methodologies, meet timelines, and escalate issues appropriately.
Relevant certifications such as:
CISA, CRISC, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001, or equivalent Information Security / GRC certification

Education & Good to Have

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.



If you are interested in exploring the above opportunity please do share your updated resume to vgayakwad@firstam.com with the below details:

Current CTC :

Expected CTC :

Notice Period :

Regards,

Vijaya
